description: Summarize EPA-regulated facilities in one US county: how many facilities (and how many active), how many have been inspected, formal enforcement actions and total penalties, how many facilities are currently in violation or significant violation, plus the worst facilities in the county (significant violations first). County is the facility's physical county from EPA/FRS coordinates, with official Census county names. A county summary is a screening view of an area, not a verdict on a specific property.
name: get_county_compliance_summary
